provenance.paper_title: The Script is All You Need: An Agentic Framework for Long-Horizon Dialogue-to-Cinematic Video Generation

representation_paths.memory_component: Last/first-frame visual anchor carried to the next scene

evidence.section: Full-paper method / memory representation and retrieval
evidence.paraphrase: Anchor frame (image) extracted per scene. The anchor frame is passed as conditioning to the next scene, with a 'continuing from the previous scene' text cue.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 6): The full-paper lifecycle review found Last/first-frame visual anchor carried to the next scene fixed during downstream inference; query-conditioned access, preprocessing, or training-time changes were not counted as persistent deployed updates. No persistent inference-time T2 update or deployment-feedback policy evolution was found.
